requirement.value: Fury, Archivist, Sharpshooter or Prizefighter mastery + Knowledge Is Power

system.description: Choose two Species; against those or humanoid, either +5 damage or inflict reeling — a bespoke primed condition (the target's first recovery is halved, then it clears), not a seventh status, so no cleanse removes it. Takeable three times. Reeling is private to this heroic: it never shares a trigger or a payout with ruptured or broken.
